description: Pricing for a directory API: the price per call after the free calls (shared across all your keys), and the add-ons available for this feed with their prices (per call when used, or per export). No subscription: pay per call from prepaid credit on your key, or with x402 when a call returns 402. Monthly plans (compliance checks + data calls + monitored names): GET /v1/plans, buy with POST /v1/plans/buy?plan=starter|pro|business and your key. Cheapest for agents: top up a key once with x402 (POST /v1/credits/topup?usd=1, 5 or 20 with the key) and calls draw from that credit.
name: get_plans
title: Get pricing for an API
